units.source_text: 常陆亲王家的小姐怕羞，一向躲躲藏藏，面貌也不肯给人看清。

en.t: The young lady of Prince Hitachi's household was shy, always keeping herself hidden, and would not let anyone see her face clearly.

units.source_text: 源氏公子也一向无心去细看她。

en.t: Prince Genji, for his part, had never really cared to look at her closely.

units.source_text: 但他想：“细看一下，也许会发现意外之美。

en.t: But he thought, "If I look carefully, I may discover some unexpected beauty.

units.source_text: 往常暗中摸索，总是模模糊糊，所以觉得她的样子奇怪，莫名其妙。

en.t: Until now I have only groped about in the dark, and everything has been vague, so her appearance has seemed strange and incomprehensible.
I really must take a proper look at her."

units.source_text: 但用灯火去照，却是不好意思的。

en.t: Yet it would have been awkward to shine a lamp on her.

units.source_text: 于是有一天晚上，当小姐独居晏处，无所顾虑的时候，

en.t: So one evening, when the young lady was alone and at ease, with nothing to make her feel guarded,

units.source_text: 他悄悄地走进去，在格子门的缝隙里窥探。

en.t: he slipped in quietly and peered through a gap in the lattice door.
But the young lady herself was nowhere to be seen.

units.source_text: 帷屏等虽然十分破旧，多年来还是照老样子整整齐齐地摆着，因此看不大清楚。

en.t: The curtains, screens, and other furnishings were very worn, yet they had been arranged neatly in the old way for years, so he could not see very clearly.

units.source_text: 但见四五个侍女正在吃饭。

en.t: All he saw was four or five serving women eating their meal.

units.source_text: 桌上放着几只中国产的青瓷碗盏，由于经济困难，饭菜十分粗劣，甚是可怜。

en.t: On the table stood several Chinese celadon bowls and cups, but because the household was poor, the food was very coarse, a pitiful sight.

units.source_text: 她们显然是刚才伺候了小姐，回到这里来吃饭。

en.t: They had evidently just finished attending on the young lady and had come back here to eat.
